title: Humain and AMD plan 500 MW of AMD-based AI compute

sources.quote: As part of the agreement, the parties will invest up to $10B to deploy 500 megawatts of AI compute capacity over the next five years.

explain: Humain will build AI data centers using AMD chips and software, 500 megawatts over five years. The headline $10B is what both companies together plan to invest, not a price Humain pays AMD, so the amount is shown as undisclosed.
